found.quote: Trinity commits to providing ongoing resources and guidance to support students and staff in the responsible and ethical use of AI and GenAI.
Programme handbooks must also clearly outline and communicate the permitted use of GenAI by students in learning activities and assessment tasks
If individual modules have further restrictions or permit greater allowances in the use of GenAI, those restrictions or allowances must be stated in the module descriptions in the Blackboard VLE.
Students should familiarise themselves with the Library Guide on Generative AI, which outlines considerations for using and acknowledging the use of Gen AI in academic work.
All students must complete a signed declaration to be submitted with all assessed coursework, declaring that they have read and understood the Library guide on Academic Integrity and Generative AI
Living Guidelines on the Responsible Use of Generative AI in Research.
